hypotheses.construction_plan: Introduce a formal diagonal-index parameter theta. The shared kernel is M(theta, theta). The two summands are obtained by specializing theta to 1 and to 2, respectively.
required_assumptions: M accepts equal integer arguments, so M(theta, theta) is well-defined for theta in {1,2}.
hypotheses.rationale: The only shared structure visible is that both terms are diagonal evaluations of the same function M, differing only by the integer index. Hence a one-parameter repeated kernel explains the two non-identical calls without altering the original sum.
